kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-express-connect-traffic-qos-queue --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --qos-id qos-2giu0a6vd5x0mv0000 --queue-id qos-queue-9nyx2u7n71s2rc0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteExpressConnectTrafficQosQueue

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the QoS policy.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
QoS策略所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
